speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. I need to understand the cause of your acute diarrhea; how long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and have you noticed any blood or mucus in your stool?

speaker: Patient
text: 58-year-old female. The patient has been treated for community-acquired pneumonia with levofloxacin on the medical floor. She reports developing watery diarrhea with at least 9 episodes within the last two days, accompanied by lower abdominal discomfort and cramping.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Clostridioides difficile infection. Given the recent use of levofloxacin and the presentation of frequent watery diarrhea with cramping, this is the most likely etiology; I will now request a stool toxin assay for confirmation.
